# Visual density

**How many things are on screen at once?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C6


## One element carries it
<a id="one-element"></a>

One idea, one image, one line. Neil French: if one element does the job, you're onto a winner.

**Looks like:** A single shot of a sunset with one line of text, held. No labels, no stickers, no meme. It doesn't look like an ad, so people watch it.

**Good at:** premium feel; clarity; stands out in busy feeds

**Weak at:** less retention on long reels; the one element must be strong

**Best for:** formats reel30, carousel, story · niches travel, all · goals shares, trust · effort low

**How:** Pick the single strongest shot and line. Remove everything else.

**Backed by:** [One element can carry it](../topics/text.md#text-one-element), [One idea beats many](../topics/brand.md#brand-one-idea), [Structure = dividing lines + parallelism](../topics/story.md#story-dividing-lines-parallelism), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall), [Make it concrete and visual](../topics/text.md#text-zoom-in-concrete) · sources L09

## Layered: audio, visual and text together
<a id="layered-three-channel"></a>

Say it, show it and write it at once; something changes every 1.5–2.5 s.

**Looks like:** Voice, picture and caption carry the same idea; a new card or cut arrives every two seconds with a sound.

**Good at:** retention; sound-off and sound-on viewers; clarity

**Weak at:** edit time; can feel busy

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, reach · effort medium

**How:** Plan visual changes on the script every ~2 s; captions on; SFX on the changes.

**Backed by:** [Context in the first words, three channels](../topics/hooks.md#hook-context-first-words), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s), [Structure = dividing lines + parallelism](../topics/story.md#story-dividing-lines-parallelism), [Untangle: hook, format, topic, illustration](../topics/growth.md#growth-untangle-data), [Make it concrete and visual](../topics/text.md#text-zoom-in-concrete) · sources L01, L02, R1

## Calm camera, busy overlays
<a id="overlays-on-calm-camera"></a>

Few camera cuts; cards, freezes and overlays enter and leave about every 2 s.

**Looks like:** One locked desk shot for ~10 s at a time while repo cards, prompt bars and a grade panel slide in on the exact words. Only about six full-frame cuts in 85 s.

**Good at:** fast pace without jumpy cuts; tutorials; proof on the word

**Weak at:** many graphics to build; needs word-level timing

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech · goals retention, saves · effort high

**How:** faster-whisper word timings, then HyperFrames cards timed to each word.

**Backed by:** [Tool card lands on the word](../topics/text.md#l10-card-on-the-word), [Type the real prompt on screen](../topics/text.md#l10-prompt-bar-on-screen), [Graphic yap: one overlay every ~2 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-graphic-yap-overlay-2s), [3x3 wall of reels proves a trend](../topics/effects.md#l10-3x3-reel-wall), [Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example) · sources L10

## Chaotic: memes, layouts and images every 1–2 s
<a id="chaotic-graphic"></a>

Images, memes, layout swaps and labels change constantly.

**Looks like:** Talking head, then a meme with the GPU pasted in, then a parts card, then a B&W freeze, then a road-sign graphic, all within ten seconds.

**Good at:** retention; humour; energy

**Weak at:** can overwhelm; lots of assets; less premium

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gaming · goals retention, shares · effort high

**How:** About 30 images per 60 s as CapCut overlays; meme cutaways of 1–3 s.

**Backed by:** [Graphic yap: one overlay every ~2 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-graphic-yap-overlay-2s), [Meme cutaways with the product pasted in](../topics/editing.md#edit-meme-cutaways), [Switch layouts every few seconds](../topics/editing.md#edit-layout-switching), [Carousel: one image + 1–2 sentences](../topics/text.md#text-carousel-one-image), [Make it concrete and visual](../topics/text.md#text-zoom-in-concrete) · sources L06, R1

## Mixing
A one-element hook can open a layered body. Harry speaks about print ads, the others about video, so 'one idea per reel, layered delivery' is a common blend.

## Rule of thumb
Vibe and premium: one element. Teaching: layered or calm camera with overlays. Comedy and energy: chaotic.
